settings.heading: Where Ancient Loom Traditions Meet Contemporary Grace
settings.quote: Eighteen stitches in every inch—a master artisan's mark of patience, precision, and conscious luxury.
settings.text: 18 Stitches was born from an intimate reverence for India's textile provenance. Rejecting mass-market churn, each capsule is handcrafted in small batches, bridging the timeless artistry of Chanderi and Banarasi master weavers with effortless modern drapes.
